title: $S\mapsto\Spec LC(S,\Z)$ preserves coverings
statement:
Let $\{S_i\to S\}_{i\in I}$ be a finite jointly surjective family of profinite
sets. Then $\{\Spec LC(S_i,\Z)\to\Spec LC(S,\Z)\}_{i\in I}$ is a covering in
$(\Spec\Z)_{\mathrm{proét}}$ ([def-weil-pbc-proetale-site]). Since the
coherent topology is generated by such families, $u$
([def-sfb-profinite-to-proetale]) is cover preserving.

proof.text: A coherent covering sieve contains a finite effective epimorphic family of profinite maps, equivalently a jointly surjective family. By [lem-weil-pbc-locally-constant-prime-spectrum], each point of Spec LC(T,Z) has the form (t,p). Choose a member and a preimage s of t; the point (s,p) maps to (t,p), proving joint surjectivity of the spectrum family. Each family arrow is weakly etale by cancellation against the weakly etale structure maps of [lem-sfb-lc-weakly-etale]. It is quasi-compact because it is an affine spectrum map. Thus Scheme.Cover.ofQuasiCompactCover gives a covering for the pro-etale precoverage [def-weil-pbc-proetale-site]. The generated image sieve is covering, and its inclusion in the pushed-forward original sieve finishes cover preservation.
